name: Audible
description: Audible is a leading creator and provider of premium audio storytelling and audiobooks, operating as a wholly-owned subsidiary of public parent company Amazon.com, Inc.

stock.note: Audible is a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) and does not have a separate stock ticker.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled using a category-typical digital audio/subscription streaming marketing expense ratio of 15% to 25% applied against Audible's reported annual revenue of $200 million USD.
